title: Edward Elgar's birth chart
metaDescription: Edward Elgar's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.8° Gemini. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Four of the ten placements whose signs are settled stand in Taurus — Venus, Jupiter, Uranus and Pluto. The placements whose signs could change with an unknown hour are not counted. A cluster that size becomes the section the rest of the chart plays around.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Gemini, but precisely: 11.8°, second decan, 10°–20°, under Venus in the triplicity scheme. The tradition kept these divisions because thirty degrees is a long street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 10.1° Gemini; Venus stands at 11.5° Taurus; Mars stands at 13.1° Gemini. The tradition reads a mind at home in argument and pattern from Mercury, taste for the substantial and the lasting from Venus, drive that argues its way forward from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: the Sun to Mars, a conjunction with 1.3° of slack. When two functions occupy one degree, the tradition reads a fusion: neither can act without committing the other. Behind it, Venus sextile Saturn at 1.6°, and the Sun conjunction Mercury at 1.8° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Each angle here was measured at every hour of the civil day and held; whatever the missing clock said, this geometry was in it.

blocks.title: The standing structure
blocks.text: The day-stable angles form no closed figure. Nothing funnels; each aspect is its own negotiation, which the tradition reads as a chart of separate treaties rather than one campaign.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Three planets here sit in a sign the classical scheme scores. Mercury in Gemini at 10.1° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Venus in Taurus at 11.5° is in domicile; Saturn in Cancer at 13.1° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain. Condition, not character: that is all the dignity table ever measured.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Tallied where the signs are certain — 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day — the chart gives air 4, earth 4, water 2, and mutable 4, fixed 4, cardinal 2 across the modes. No settled placement falls in fire — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mercury was retrograde — the backward drift a body appears to make as the Earth overtakes it, read in the scheme as a function that reviews before it releases.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Libra for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 11.9° between midnight and midnight. Whatever the unrecorded hour was, it happened inside one Moon sign — the degree floats, the sign holds. At the noon reference it stands at 14.7°.
